terminals.name: next-dev
terminals.description: Next.js dev server with HMR on http://localhost:3000. Best for iterating on UI/pages; the /api/* Worker routes are not served here (use the wrangler terminal for those).

terminals.name: wrangler
terminals.description: Full-stack preview on http://localhost:8787: runs `next build` (static export to ./out) then serves it with the Cloudflare Worker (worker/index.ts), so the /api/status, /api/ask, and /api/contact routes work locally.
